name: Dux Theme Sync
description: Linux theming is a dozen config systems that never met. This makes one decision - Dux's - reach GTK2/3/4, Qt, Kvantum, KDE, Flatpak, Fontconfig and XSettings, verifies it landed, and picks the GTK-Qt route (theme pairs, Kvantum, qt6ct-kde, qtengine-aware) that this machine can actually serve
author: arqueon
